question.worked_solution:
If $X$ follows a discrete uniform distribution over a set $S,$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{|S|}, & x\in S \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, we have $X∼U\{9,10,11,…,17\},$ and the set $S=\{9,10,11,…,17\}$ has $|S|=17-9+1=9$ items. So, we have

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{9}, & x=9,10,11,…,17 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

In $S,$ the items that satisfy $X<12$ are $9,10,11.$ There are $3$ of these items. Therefore,

$$
P(X<12)=3\cdot \frac{1}{9}=\frac{1}{3}.
$$
